_about: How the Takemikazuchi's Type-74 blade (Project MIKHAIL equip/weapon/bl74_00) sits in Ronin's sword files.
Hand-authored; this file is the whole fit.  The blade is used as it is: one rigid copy, at the same scale as the body
(units per metre are read from the body's fit), so sword and machine keep Project MIKHAIL's proportions.
Project MIKHAIL attaches the blade to the hand at its 'equip' marker, which is the model's own origin, on the black
handle.  Ronin's sword files have the hand at their origin too (the weapon bone).  So origin goes on origin.
Ronin's sword: blade along +Y (tip bone at y = 148.9), cutting edge towards +Z (edge bone at z = +9.0), thickness X.
Type-74 as cleaned: blade along -Y (tip marker 'blade2' at y = -12.2 m), belly and cutting edge towards -Z, thickness X.
So the blade is turned half a turn about its thickness axis: (x, y, z) -> (x, -y, -z).  Rows are Ronin's X, Y, Z.

checks._about: the build stops if the fitted blade's tip is further than this from Ronin's own tip bone along the blade, or points the wrong way

mesh_bone._about: the bone that carries the whole sword mesh in each stock file (read from the file, checked against this)
